capacity.note: Realized lift scaled by fill fraction = min(1, participation_cap x print_size); saturates at cap=1. Impact-driven decay above cap requires flagship depth data (Phase 0).

cost_attribution.note: Disclosed cost model applied to the measured gross edge (maker posting assumption); not a claim of realized fills.

fills.fee_tier_note: Hyperliquid base perps tier; funding_rate_bps is the mean recorded funding over the requested symbols and dates.

regimes.note: Vol-tercile x time-of-day small multiples need enough samples to form stable buckets; the 8-row synthetic lake cannot. Populates on flagship runs (Phase 0).
